{{Attr|Freeze}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Health Ritual}}''' - Heals any enemy in a radius of 8 by 1,100 every 0.1 seconds. }} ==Description== The '''Healing Beacon''', internally referred to as just '''Beacon''', is a support enemy that appears in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes. It is not a regular as on top of only appearing when summoned, it is completely invulnerable to damage, has only 1 health and when entering the exit deals no damage and instead just disappears. It instead has a lifetime of 6, which means once 6 seconds pass, it will disappear from the path. When on the path, it will heal any enemy on the circle, which has a radius of 8, by 1,100 every 0.1 seconds. ==Appearance== The '''Healing Beacon''' is a purple incantation circle. It has multiple purple plus signs and waves coming out of it. ==Strategy== *It is impossible to stop or kill the '''Healing Beacons'''. **Kill the [[Void Cultist]] as quickly as possible to limit the amount of '''Healing Beacons''' spawned. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Miscellanous}} DefaultEnemyIconIG.png|'''Healing Beacon''' on its bugged [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Healing Beacon''' is the second fastest enemy in the game. **With only 1 health, it also has the lowest health of any enemy in the game. *Despite appearing as a spawnable enemy in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, you cannot collect this [[Logbooks|logbook]]. **Therefore, the only way to spawn this enemy in is to have the Sandbox Plus+ gamepass. *The '''Healing Beacon''' is the second evergreen enemy to have its [[Logbooks|Logbook]] unobtainable, the first being the [[Molten Hazmat]]. *The '''Healing Beacon''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Healing Beacon''' added. **{{Bug}} Lifetime is not affected by [[Time Scale]]. **{{Bug}} '''Healing Beacon''' has a broken icon in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]] **Health regeneration increased from 675 to 1,100. {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Hardcore]] [[Category:Voidcore]]
